domains.label: Acute injury, acute support, fluid and biochemical disorders
Cardiovascular, blood pressure and diabetes care

alignments.label: Urine, serology and tissue interpretation
alignments.scope_note: Diagnostic decisions and sampling limitations; the pathology items use text, not diagnostic images.
gaps: No reviewed IgA/IgAV or anti-GBM-specific assessment; no image-based histology assessment.

alignments.label: Disease response and competing treatment risks
alignments.scope_note: FSGS, membranous response, infection-related reasoning and thrombosis/bleeding tradeoffs.
gaps: No complete disease-by-disease induction, maintenance, relapse or drug-monitoring bank.

alignments.label: Systemic inflammation and microvascular injury
alignments.scope_note: Lupus, AAV and TMA recognition/etiology are selected contexts within the curriculum's immune/systemic scope.
gaps: No comprehensive complement-disease treatment or anti-GBM pathway.

alignments.label: Tubular localization and interstitial-injury reasoning
alignments.scope_note: Proximal losses, drug-related glycosuria, AIN test limits and acidification interpretation; these are not four AIN treatment items.
gaps: No comprehensive interstitial treatment course or inherited salt-wasting assessment.

alignments.label: Nonalbumin proteins and renal deposition workup
alignments.scope_note: MGRS and amyloid investigation; assignment is an assistant interpretation of the immune/systemic curriculum context.
gaps: No comprehensive cancer-treatment toxicity, myeloma or clone-directed therapy assessment.

alignments.label: Plasma exchange as a distinct mechanism
alignments.scope_note: A TTP plasma-exchange distinction; the case prompts etiologic and urgent specialist reasoning.
gaps: No complete disease-specific plasma-exchange indication or complication matrix.

alignments.label: Acute injury definitions and staging
alignments.scope_note: Creatinine/urine-output definitions and limits of an unknown baseline.
gaps: No exhaustive etiologic AKI differential or all post-AKI outcomes.

alignments.label: Cause review, recovery and medicine-related AKI
alignments.scope_note: Diuretics, low-dose dopamine, fractional excretion limits, follow-up and hemodynamic drug interactions.
gaps: No complete shock/sepsis resuscitation, hepatorenal or tumor-lysis bank.

alignments.label: Measurements during changing kidney function
alignments.scope_note: Non-steady-state estimates and acute medication decisions.
gaps: No measured-clearance or kinetic-estimation curriculum.

alignments.label: Acute support delivery and cessation
alignments.scope_note: Circulatory tolerance, dose arithmetic, downtime and stopping support. The citrate question's apheresis-objective link is not counted as direct alignment.
gaps: No comprehensive acute-access procedure, circuit troubleshooting or poisoning/toxin assessment; citrate item needs an objective-metadata revision before formal inclusion.

alignments.label: Water, sodium and correction reasoning
alignments.scope_note: Tonicity, urine dilution, effective volume and monitored correction.
gaps: No reviewed hypernatremia or diabetes-insipidus assessment.

alignments.label: Potassium and metabolic acid-base patterns
alignments.scope_note: Hyperkalemia, redistribution/removal, CKD alkali monitoring and selected gap/RTA interpretation.
gaps: No systematic hypokalemia, metabolic alkalosis or mixed respiratory/acid-base bank.

alignments.label: Chronicity, filtration markers and urine quantification
alignments.scope_note: Marker/measurement limitations support CKD decisions; they do not establish every foundational science objective.
gaps: No complete persistent-hematuria workup or structural CKD differential.

alignments.label: Progression risk and longitudinal protection
alignments.scope_note: Risk-tool applicability, SGLT2 protection and change evaluation.
gaps: No full cause-specific longitudinal CKD management or complications matrix.

alignments.label: Preparing for replacement therapy
alignments.scope_note: Clinical initiation and anticipatory planning; not proof of maintenance dialysis competence.
gaps: No complete education/modality/access selection bank.

alignments.label: Mineral and bone trend interpretation
alignments.scope_note: PTH/calcium/phosphate, binder exposure and low-turnover concerns.
gaps: No comprehensive fracture, osteoporosis or calciphylaxis assessment.

alignments.label: Anemia investigation and ESA goals
alignments.scope_note: Two exact reviewed items; no anemia teaching case is claimed.
gaps: No comprehensive iron-treatment, ESA hyporesponse, transfusion or HIF-PHI bank.

alignments.label: Blood pressure validity and tolerance
alignments.scope_note: Measurement settings, masked patterns and tolerated treatment.
gaps: No complete secondary-hypertension, renovascular or emergency-treatment bank.

alignments.label: Diabetes protection and treatment interpretation
alignments.scope_note: Selected kidney-protective mechanisms, metformin, fasting and HbA1c limitations.
gaps: No complete insulin adjustment, pancreatic transplantation or diabetes complication bank.

alignments.label: Cardiac/kidney risk and shared care
alignments.scope_note: Albuminuria risk and medication benefit versus manageable potassium.
gaps: No comprehensive heart-failure, ischemia or dialysis cardiovascular assessment.

alignments.label: An infected obstructed system
alignments.scope_note: Urgent source-control reasoning.
gaps: No complete chronic obstruction, congenital tract or imaging pathway.

alignments.label: Stone composition and metabolic prevention
alignments.scope_note: Selected calcium, oxalate, citrate and urine-pH mechanisms.
gaps: No complete stone-procedure or metabolic differential bank.

alignments.label: Routine and recurrent urinary infection
alignments.scope_note: Recurrent symptomatic lower UTI investigation and stepwise prevention, with a reviewed teaching case.
gaps: Finite launch cells do not cover every acute/upper UTI, pregnancy, resistance or antimicrobial-dose pathway.

alignments.label: ADPKD progression and family considerations
alignments.scope_note: ADPKD imaging/progression, family history and treatment monitoring.
gaps: No complete cascade-testing or genetic-variant interpretation bank.

alignments.label: Genetic and metabolic disease beyond ADPKD
alignments.scope_note: Alport-spectrum phenotype/testing and contextual variant interpretation. The T12 tag is secondary; ADPKD objectives are not used to claim Alport coverage.
gaps: Fabry, cystinosis, primary hyperoxaluria, inherited salt-wasting and full genetic/metabolic management remain broader-curriculum ambitions.

alignments.label: PD transport, residual function and fluid removal
alignments.scope_note: Two PD-specific questions plus a volume/clearance case.
gaps: No complete PD prescription or ultrafiltration-failure algorithm.

alignments.label: PD infection and catheter complications
alignments.scope_note: PD peritonitis recognition and separate exit-site/tunnel assessment with continuing-access review.
gaps: No complete organism/dose, refractory/relapsing infection or catheter-complication treatment algorithm.

alignments.label: HD dose, modalities and overall adequacy
alignments.scope_note: Diffusion/convection and membrane differences; no HD-focused staged case is claimed. Existing urea/adequacy questions point to a dialysis-initiation objective and are excluded from formal alignment.
gaps: No complete maintenance/home-HD prescription, water-quality or complication case bank; two adequacy items need objective-metadata revisions.

alignments.label: Urgent removal after a missed HD treatment
alignments.scope_note: One maintenance-HD emergency item; general hyperkalemia items remain in the acute domain.
gaps: No complete intradialytic emergency bank.

alignments.label: HD access and unit operation
alignments.scope_note: Ongoing HD access and unit care: clinical assessment, aneurysm/stenosis, trained aseptic catheter use and focused session teaching.
gaps: No complete HD prescription, all unit emergencies, water-system or procedure-competence curriculum.

alignments.label: Candidate and donor eligibility
alignments.scope_note: Preemptive assessment, candidate comorbidity and selected donor measurements. The cancer-remission item has an infection-objective link and is excluded from direct alignment.
gaps: No deceased-donor selection/allocation or complete candidate-assessment bank; cancer item needs an objective-metadata revision.

alignments.label: Sensitization and pretransplant infection planning
alignments.scope_note: HLA-antibody reassessment and infection/vaccine timing before transplant.
gaps: No posttransplant virology, prophylaxis or immunosuppressant-level assessment.

alignments.label: Voluntary donation and future pregnancy
alignments.scope_note: Autonomy and selected donor counseling, not a national legal qualification.
gaps: No complete donor psychosocial or jurisdiction-specific legal assessment.

alignments.label: Transplant dysfunction and longer-term care
alignments.scope_note: Recipient BK surveillance, medication-risk review and graft dysfunction uncertainty. Pre-transplant T21 objectives are not used as aftercare evidence.
gaps: No complete rejection regimen, all post-transplant infections, malignancy or long-term recipient-aftercare curriculum.

alignments.label: Kidney-aware prescribing and transitions
alignments.scope_note: Dose metrics, non-GFR influences, combinations, OTC exposures and restart responsibility.
gaps: No complete pharmacokinetic, drug-level or dialysis-removal bank.

alignments.label: Infection assessment around immune treatment
alignments.scope_note: HBV risk and selected case infection reasoning; pretransplant vaccine items are counted only in the transplant domain.
gaps: No complete infection-prevention, opportunistic infection or dialysis virology bank.

alignments.label: Kidney assessment and tissue decisions in pregnancy
alignments.scope_note: Creatinine/eGFR limits, superimposed preeclampsia and selected biopsy decisions.
gaps: No complete prepregnancy, transplant pregnancy, pregnancy immunosuppression or HELLP assessment.

alignments.label: Nutritional context and restriction tradeoffs
alignments.scope_note: Adult, frailty, pediatric growth and acute-support nutrition contexts.
gaps: No complete dialysis diet, rehabilitation or nutritional-assessment bank.

alignments.label: Conservative care and changing goals
alignments.scope_note: Active conservative care, frailty and revisiting preferences.
gaps: No complete symptom-prescribing or dialysis-withdrawal assessment.

alignments.label: Procedure indications and limitations
alignments.scope_note: Selected biopsy decisions; a second link within Other does not double-count its question. Text learning cannot certify hands-on procedure competence.
gaps: No technical catheter insertion, asepsis, consent or procedural-complication assessment.

alignments.label: Fertility, contraception and sexual health
alignments.scope_note: A private informed contraception decision with dialysis and potassium/drug safety; supplementary US eligibility evidence is labelled.
gaps: Comprehensive fertility, pregnancy and sexual-dysfunction evaluation remain broader-curriculum ambitions.

alignments.label: Transition to adult kidney care
alignments.scope_note: Developmentally supported child/adult transition, recipient medication continuity and re-engagement.
gaps: No complete pediatric disease/treatment or transplant-adherence intervention curriculum; no educational outcome claim.

alignments.label: Care during dying and dialysis withdrawal
alignments.scope_note: An actual dialysis-withdrawal/possible-dying scenario with uncertainty, continuing support and individualized medication/route review.
gaps: No complete kidney-specific terminal symptom or drug-dose protocol; no single time-to-death prediction.

alignments.label: Evidence interpretation for learning
alignments.scope_note: Generic curriculum research/critical-appraisal support; no exam-domain assignment is inferred for these four questions.
gaps: Not counted as ESENeph blueprint coverage.
